description: This tool looks up a deterministic rules engine. Same day → same answer. Do not invent pillars or fortune claims. Call when the user asks 今天什么时候适合运动 / 今天哪个时辰适合深工 / 什么时候开会 / 什么时候练 / 什么时候发版 / 什么时候该休息 / activity window / when to exercise. Maps month posture × twelve hours × body load to 2–3 clock windows for task=deep_work|train|meet|ship|rest. Windows are suggested slots, not a guarantee. Not meds, not glucose, not a diagnosis. Public · local · no API key. Preview ≠ prediction.

date.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in Asia/Shanghai. Use when the user asks about a specific day.

task.description: What to place: deep_work (default), train, meet, ship, rest.
